title: CandidateFindingsV1
description: Version 1 of the deterministic telemetry-query connector artifact (TEL-045).

schema.description: Immutable wire identifier for the candidate-findings artifact version.

since.description: The inclusive lower bound used for the query.

findings.description: Deterministically selected telemetry anomalies proposed for follow-up work.

causalCredit.description: Causal estimates and explicit cannot-identify verdicts for workflow nodes.

attributionCohorts.description: Stored run attribution evidence aggregated by effective version and workload cohort.

promotionSignals.description: All bounded promotion evidence, including ineligible correlational fallbacks.

promotionCandidates.description: Machine-filtered causal signals that are eligible for automated nomination or promotion.

examples.caveat: Eligible only for the observed randomized cohort.

promotionEligible.description: Every item crossing the promotionCandidates boundary is promotion-eligible.

source.description: The promotionCandidates boundary excludes correlational fallback sources.

noWork.description: Whether the query found no actionable telemetry candidates.

note.description: Human-readable explanation accompanying a no-work result or candidate set.

kind.description: Stable anomaly category detected by the telemetry query.

subject.description: Workflow, stage, gate, or error signature affected by the anomaly.

metrics.description: Measured values that caused the candidate to be selected.

threshold.description: Configured comparison boundary that the measured value crossed.

flagged_runs.description: Run-journal references that provide evidence for the anomaly.

nomination_guardrails.description: Machine-readable checks required before a credit-assignment finding may become a nomination.

signature.description: The normalized stable finding signature shared by the clustered learning episodes.

classification.description: The governed durable-learning classification for this finding cluster.

recommendedAction.description: The single governed action family allowed to consume this learning cluster.

error_class.description: Normalized error category (e.g. infra, timeout) for an error-signature finding — the other half of the (code, error_class) clustering key that subject alone cannot carry, since two findings can share a code but differ only in error_class.

dedupe_key.description: Stable node and fault-family key used to suppress duplicate nominations.

requires_upstream_cause_check.description: The nominator must reject attribution when journal or repo evidence identifies an upstream cause.

requires_human_review.description: True when deterministic node classification identifies a governing gate, prompt, or workflow.

governing_target_treatment.description: If the target governs its evaluator, require human review and prohibit removing, weakening, or bypassing that evaluator.

runId.description: Run carrying the linked attribution evidence.

nodeId.description: Graph node the evidence link points back to.

stage.description: Stage whose journaled event or artifact carries the evidence.

detail.description: Human-readable attribution detail derived from the run-level credit analysis.

source.description: Attribution evidence class or contribution family this link represents.

journalSequence.description: Exact journal sequence number of the referenced event.

journalPath.description: Journal file containing the referenced event.

artifactPath.description: Journal-relative path of the exact artifact or span blob carrying the evidence, when one exists.

artifactDigest.description: Content digest of the exact artifact or span blob carrying the evidence, when one exists.

artifactMediaType.description: Recorded media type of the artifact or span blob carrying the evidence, when one exists.

nodes.description: Ordered path of graph nodes contributing to the cohorted attribution.

share.description: Mean attribution share of the repeated path across contributing runs.

confidence.description: Mean confidence of the repeated path across contributing runs.

evidence.description: Exact journal-backed links supporting one contributing path occurrence.

effectiveVersion.description: Stable version-segmented cohort key derived from workflow/goober digests and run provenance.

workload.description: Workload bucket grouping runs that share the same trigger/work class.

runCount.description: How many stored runs contributed attribution evidence to the cohort aggregate.

topContributingPaths.description: Highest-share repeated attribution paths observed across the cohort's runs.

counterEvidence.description: Exact journal-backed links to contradictory or retry-based counter-evidence observed in the cohort.

examples.caveat: No trusted randomized assignment or valid comparison cohort.

effect.description: Identified effect, or the retained correlational contrast when promotionSource is correlational-fallback.

lower.description: Lower confidence bound when an interval is available.

upper.description: Upper confidence bound when an interval is available.

identification.description: Identification strategy, or unidentifiable when causal conditions are unmet.

treatedBefore.description: Treated cohort size before the intervention.

treatedAfter.description: Treated cohort size after the intervention.

controlBefore.description: Control cohort size before the intervention.

controlAfter.description: Control cohort size after the intervention.

intervalAvailable.description: Whether the bounds are a promotion-eligible causal confidence interval.

promotionEligible.description: Whether this identified estimate may cross the automated promotion boundary.

promotionSource.description: Identified causal strategy, or correlational-fallback when ineligible.

hasCohortData.description: Whether an experiment actually ran on this node (non-zero cohort counts), distinguishing a genuine identification failure from a node that has never had a versioned changepoint or routed identity recorded at all.

examples.caveat: No trusted randomized assignment or valid comparison cohort.

value.description: Causal effect when eligible, otherwise the preserved correlational fallback value.

lower.description: Lower causal confidence bound for an eligible signal.

upper.description: Upper causal confidence bound for an eligible signal.

caveat.description: Identification caveat that must accompany the signal.

promotionEligible.description: Whether this signal may cross the machine-filtered promotion boundary.

runId.description: The run whose journal contains evidence for this finding.

seq.description: The exact journal event sequence containing the evidence.
